```artifact
Feature: Prescription Management

  Scenario: One Prescription per Patient Consultation Request
    Given a Patient Consultation Request exists
    When the request is processed
    Then exactly one prescription is generated

  Scenario: One Prescription per Patient Consultation Request (Edge Case)
    Given a Patient Consultation Request with no medication exists
    When the request is processed
    Then no prescription is generated

  Scenario: One Prescription per Patient Consultation Request (Invalid Case)
    Given a Patient Consultation Request with invalid medication exists
    When the request is processed
    Then an error is raised

  Scenario: One Prescription per Patient Consultation Request (Boundary Case)
    Given a Patient Consultation Request with maximum allowed medication exists
    When the request is processed
    Then exactly one prescription is generated

  Scenario: One Prescription per Patient Consultation Request (Normal Case)
    Given a Patient Consultation Request with valid medication exists
    When the request is processed
    Then exactly one prescription is generated

  Scenario: One Prescription per Patient Consultation Request (Multiple Requests)
    Given multiple Patient Consultation Requests exist
    When the requests are processed
    Then each request generates exactly one prescription

  Scenario: Prescription Mapping to Patient Consultation Request
    Given a Patient Consultation Request and a Prescription exist
    When the prescription is mapped to the request
    Then the prescription is mapped to the request

  Scenario: Prescription Mapping to Patient Consultation Request (Edge Case)
    Given a Patient Consultation Request and a Prescription with no mapping exist
    When the prescription is mapped to the request
    Then an error is raised

  Scenario: Prescription Mapping to Patient Consultation Request (Invalid Case)
    Given a Patient Consultation Request and a Prescription with invalid mapping exist
    When the prescription is mapped to the request
    Then an error is raised

  Scenario: Prescription Mapping to Patient Consultation Request (Boundary Case)
    Given a Patient Consultation Request and a Prescription with maximum allowed mapping exist
    When the prescription is mapped to the request
    Then the prescription is mapped to the request

  Scenario: Prescription Mapping to Patient Consultation Request (Normal Case)
    Given a Patient Consultation Request and a Prescription with valid mapping exist
    When the prescription is mapped to the request
    Then the prescription is mapped to the request

  Scenario: Multiple Prescriptions per Patient Consultation Request
    Given a Patient Consultation Request and multiple Prescriptions exist
    When the prescriptions are mapped to the request
    Then each prescription is mapped to the request

  Scenario: Multiple Prescriptions per Patient Consultation Request (Edge Case)
    Given a Patient Consultation Request and multiple Prescriptions with no mapping exist
    When the prescriptions are mapped to the request
    Then an error is raised

  Scenario: Multiple Prescriptions per Patient Consultation Request (Invalid Case)
    Given a Patient Consultation Request and multiple Prescriptions with invalid mapping exist
    When the prescriptions are mapped to the request
    Then an error is raised

  Scenario: Multiple Prescriptions per Patient Consultation Request (Boundary Case)
    Given a Patient Consultation Request and multiple Prescriptions with maximum allowed mapping exist
    When the prescriptions are mapped to the request
    Then each prescription is mapped to the request

  Scenario: Multiple Prescriptions per Patient Consultation Request (Normal Case)
    Given a Patient Consultation Request and multiple Prescriptions with valid mapping exist
    When the prescriptions are mapped to the request
    Then each prescription is mapped to the request

  Scenario Outline: Chemist Receives Prescriptions
    Given a Chemist exists
    And a Prescription exists
    When the prescription is received by the Chemist
    Then the Chemist receives the prescription

    Examples:
      | Chemist ID | Prescription ID |
      | 1          | 1              |
      | 1          | 2              |
      | 2          | 1              |
      | 2          | 2              |
      | 3          | 1              |
      | 3          | 2              |

  Scenario Outline: Lab Receives Prescriptions
    Given a Lab exists
    And a Prescription exists
    When the prescription is received by the Lab
    Then the Lab receives the prescription

    Examples:
      | Lab ID | Prescription ID |
      | 1      | 1              |
      | 1      | 2              |
      | 2      | 1              |
      | 2      | 2              |
      | 3      | 1              |
      | 3      | 2              |

  Scenario Outline: Prescription Mapping to Chemist
    Given a Chemist exists
    And a Prescription exists
    When the prescription is mapped to the Chemist
    Then the prescription is mapped to the Chemist

    Examples:
      | Chemist ID | Prescription ID |
      | 1          | 1              |
      | 1          | 2              |
      | 2          | 1              |
      | 2          | 2              |
      | 3          | 1              |
      | 3          | 2              |

  Scenario Outline: Prescription Mapping to Lab
    Given a Lab exists
    And a Prescription exists
    When the prescription is mapped to the Lab
    Then the prescription is mapped to the Lab

    Examples:
      | Lab ID | Prescription ID |
      | 1      | 1              |
      | 1      | 2              |
      | 2      | 1              |
      | 2      | 2              |
      | 3      | 1              |
      | 3      | 2              |
```
